description: Defines interfaces and data structures for the SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) processor in a 5G NR context, including the ssb_processor class, its PDU structure, and a validator interface.

classes.name: ocudu::ssb_processor
classes.description: Interface for processing SSB PDUs and generating signals in a resource grid.

classes.name: ocudu::ssb_pdu_validator
classes.description: Interface for validating SSB processor configuration parameters.

methods.name: ocudu::ssb_processor::process
methods.description: Processes the SS/PBCH Block PDU and writes the resulting signal into the resource grid.

methods.name: ocudu::ssb_pdu_validator::is_valid
methods.description: Validates the parameters of the SS/PBCH Block PDU.
